prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: coordinated interior concept refinement, Sunlit Garden dining room, one full view.
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target, the already approved dark chestnut/cherry dining table trial.
Primary request: Refine the styling while preserving this exact bright room, camera, architecture, window, glass kitchen enclosure, furniture placements, table geometry and matte dark chestnut table finish. Retain the pale wood woven dining chairs and slim pale bench, fine ivory striped bench cushion, warm white coffee-cabinet doors, pale honey oak countertop and floating shelf, pale floor and white kitchen. The intended mood is bright warm-white daylight, fresh sage green, fine ivory stripes, pale honey wood with a few matte warm dark brown accents, never a heavy dark room.
Specific changes:
1. The coffee machine/grinder tray becomes matte dark warm chestnut wood matching the table, fine proportions. On the shelf reduce the cups to a considered cluster of four cream/sage ceramic cups, one small picture and one slim branch vase; remove the loose cutting board from the shelf. Keep generous empty shelf space, no visual clutter.
2. Add a clearly visible portable POWER STRIP at the coffee station, to the RIGHT of the black grinder, on the dry rear wall slightly above the countertop. It is an ordinary short horizontal rounded rectangular warm ivory/cream plastic extension power strip, about 28 cm long, with three Chinese grounded socket positions and a small master switch, held in two discreet removable wall clips, visibly a detachable portable item with one warm-white power cord emerging from its end and clipped neatly down the rear corner. It is NOT a long metal track and NOT hardwired sockets integrated into the plaster. Its switch is accessible. Two short appliance cords connect naturally to sockets and tuck behind the tray; no dangling cable loops or cables crossing the clear working surface. Make the strip visible in this full view rather than hidden behind appliances. Move the coffee-bean jar a little right as needed to leave clear access under the strip; fold one green-and-ivory stripe cloth at the far right front. Keep the leafy plant on the LEFT end of the cabinet, separated from power strip and hot steam.
3. Retain simple ivory runner and cream cups on dining table, with one low simple sage bowl of pears. No additional decorative objects.
Invariants: exact same 1536x1024 landscape composition, sunny exposure and camera perspective, existing door/window positions, table and chair dimensions and clear kitchen passage. The espresso machine stays the compact ivory rectangular machine with front round controls from this target; black grinder stays its current model. Preserve physically plausible cabinet joinery and leg connections.
Style: photoreal interior photograph, believable grain, fine woven textiles, brushed silver coffee fittings, subtle warm task light under shelf and natural neutral-warm daylight. No humans, labels, overlay, panels, text or watermark.

Input image: the EDIT TARGET, an approved bright Sunlit Garden coffee station concept.
Make ONLY a tiny electrical-detail correction to the warm-ivory portable strip to the RIGHT of the grinder.
The bar has THREE socket positions from left to right, then ONE master rocker switch.
Position 1: KEEP the existing black appliance plug and its cable to grinder.
Position 2: KEEP the existing ivory appliance plug and cable back to espresso machine.
Position 3: entirely EMPTY, with just three dark narrow slits in the Chinese Type I geometry: one vertical earth slit above, two diagonal blade slits below left and right (like an inverted Y layout). This position must have NO plug and NO cable emerging from it. REMOVE completely the erroneous extra short white wire currently dropping below the third socket toward the jar lid. Restore clean wall plaster where that extra wire was. No round US sockets, no parallel US blade slots.
KEEP the single ivory supply cable emerging from the RIGHT END of the whole strip and neatly clipped vertically down the wall.
Keep exactly TWO appliance cables (one black, one ivory) plus the strip's ONE supply cable.
Everything else must remain unchanged: composition, machine/grinder design, tray, jar, cloth, plants, cupboards, daylight, palette, camera. Do not redraw, restyle or add other objects. One photograph, no text, labels, logo or watermark.
